## What landed

**(1) `steerable` delegation legs on a real run (deliverable 1).**
`DriverConfig.delegate_surface_id` declares the delegation surface; a
model call on it mints `control.delegate.proposed` — a new registered
`control.*` durable audit class (`crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`,
`crates/hh-control/src/events.rs`) — *before* execution (CC3). The
driver executes admitted delegates through `DelegatePort::delegate`
over a `StoreSeam` (the run's `Store` + writer lease —
`crates/hh-control/src/driver.rs`): a missing seam is `UnbackedPort`,
unavailable substrate is `delegation_unavailable`, a missing
`delegation_reason` refuses at `check` as `missing_delegation_reason`
(pre-existing contract, now exercised end-to-end), and substrate
refusals return to β as `EnvelopeSignal::Refused`. The audit
`control.decision` payload carries the delegate members (spec, budget
slice, permissions, reason).

**(2) `woken{peer_message}` interpretation (deliverable 2).** The
steerable interpreter selects on the wakeup *trigger*, never the
delivery lane: a `peer_message` occurrence folds into the next
`propose` as a peer-message context artefact — the S4.8
`context.artefact.delivered{kind: peer_message}` consumer half — and is
never a `steer`/`follow_up` cue even when it arrives on the steer lane
(`crates/hh-control/src/react.rs`). Pending delegate proposals fold
into admitted `delegate` decisions with reason and spec
(`steerable_folds_delegate_proposed_into_the_delegate_decision`).

**(3) `PlanWalker` — `hh/workflow@1`/`hh/program@1` real-run semantics
(deliverable 3).** Both variants now bind the one sequential
`RuntimePlan/1` interpreter (`crates/hh-control/src/walk.rs`,
`variant_for` exact — unknown refs answer `None`, never a substitute):
`step{instruction}` proposes, `step{invoke}` acts,
`branch-on-validator` verifies and fails closed to `else` on any
non-affirmative/undecided verdict, `loop` walks bounded bodies,
`delegate` emits the delegate decision and awaits child terminal,
`stop-rule` is reserved for the envelope (never a sequential step),
and exhaustion stops `completed`. Walk position rides
`state.extension.walk` so checkpoint bytes restore mid-walk; a corrupt
position is a typed invariant violation; `ModelEmitted` provenance on a
compiled-plan variant refuses typed; an empty plan refuses
`missing_procedure` — the staged park is retired for both variants,
with ADR-0256 D6's staging superseded as the ticket names. Static
compute policy mints zero `control.compute.*` rows — cue-in,
decision-out cadence (R-2.6.4's S4.7 driver unchanged).

**(4) `ctx.plan` arm-time projection (`hh-embed`).**
`arm_driver`/`arm_resume_driver` now resolve the *armed* variant's own
boundary preset via `strategy_for` (the shared react fallback is gone —
the compiled-plan family's all-`code`-but-`escalate` preset binds
through the same slot) and, for `requires.procedure` variants, project
the `RuntimePlan/1` control spine through the one honest producer:
`link` → `lower_native` over the sealed definition
(`crates/hh-embed/src/open.rs::project_compiled_plan`; ADR-0355 D2). A
sealed doc that won't link/lower refuses the arm typed; a missing
sealed doc leaves `plan = []` and the driver refuses
`missing_procedure`. `KernelSink::store_seam` wires the run's `Store` +
lease so embedded runs reach the delegate port
(`crates/hh-embed/src/runtime.rs`).

**(5) `SpawnDelegatePort` (`hh-orchestrator`).**
`crates/hh-orchestrator/src/delegate.rs` parses the spec through the
canonical `SubagentSpec::from_json` codec (malformed ⇒ typed refusal,
never a spawn), resolves `spec_ref` through the registry, and invokes
the real `hh_subagent::spawn` under `ParentBinding` — attenuation,
budget, and depth stay in the R-2.6.3 child-lease substrate (CC2; the
orchestrator never re-implements a parent-authority check). The
decision `EventRef` is the spawn idempotency key; `SpawnError::Refused`
and kernel failures map to `DelegateOutcome::Refused`.

**Regression updates.** `crates/hh-control/tests/r2_6.rs` — the three
staged-variant assertions rewritten to the walker vocabulary
(`workflow_and_program_bind_the_plan_walker_not_minimal`,
`plan_walker_*`); no other suite touched.
